# Carapace bolt

Internal ID: BoltCarapace | Type: Bolt | Source: Black forge | Crafting Materials: Wood x8, Carapace x2, Feathers x2

# Introduction

Carapace bolts are ammunition for Crossbows and are the next direct upgrade from Black metal bolts.

## Availability

• It is unlocked after acquiring Carapace and is crafted at a Black forge.

Categorias: Weapons, Bolts, Black forge recipes
